MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The resistor assortment fits my breadboards, PCB supplies, and relay module because it gives me different values to use while experimenting with circuits.",
    "The LEDs with matching resistors are plausible additions to my circuit projects, although my earlier LED purchase makes them less compelling than the resistor assortment."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The wall anchors, clamp holder, and pipe fitting each serve a specific job that my history does not show I need to do now. General DIY usefulness is not enough for me to choose them.",
    "Decorative magnet supplies do not serve the practical circuit-building purpose I recognize in my purchases, and filament assumes I have a compatible printer.",
    "The machine screws require a confirmed thread and length, while the syringe ten-pack lacks a clear current use. Neither feels justified by my past hardware purchases alone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of casters and fasteners seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "Having bought specialized project parts does not mean I need other specialized parts without a matching task or compatible equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several purchases connect around assembling circuits: breadboards, a battery holder, PCB supplies, and a relay module. Supplies that work with those items have a clearer purpose for me.",
    "An assortment is more useful when I am experimenting without a fixed component value in mind. The separate 100-ohm pack fits my interests, but I would choose the assortment this time.",
    "Existing supplies matter: more LEDs could be useful, but I have already bought some, so the need is less clear."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my circuit-building interests, but stretched my occasional hardware purchases into needs for unrelated project supplies."
}
